title: Surface View
definition: A view of the corpus computed single-source from the Substrate at a chosen resolution (overview first, drill-in on demand), preserving surrounding context at drill-in (focus+context, Cockburn et al. 2008) and signaling its own incompleteness. The human-facing read of the corpus. Never hand-maintained in parallel with the Substrate. Named "Surface View" rather than "Surface" to avoid collision with the action *Surface* (user surfaces tacit knowledge); "surface" as the noun half of "substrate-and-surface" remains acceptable in the compound.
product_origin: "a high-level picture that then leads to sub-system pictures"; "see it at different resolutions" (Solo Developer, research log §Step 1.4)
aliases: Surface (as a noun, outside the compound "substrate-and-surface")
